mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pisces_experiment_config_draft (experiment_id, draft_version, base_config_version, metadata_json, updated_by, draft_comment) VALUES (#{entity.experimentId}, 1, #{entity.baseConfigVersion}, #{entity.metadataJson}, #{entity.updatedBy}, #{entity.draftComment}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE draft_version = draft_version + 1, base_config_version = VALUES(base_config_version), metadata_json = VALUES(metadata_json), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), draft_comment = VALUES(draft_comment), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, experiment_id, draft_version, base_config_version, metadata_json, updated_by, draft_comment, created_at, updated_at FROM pisces_experiment_config_draft WHERE experiment_id = #{experimentId}
